title: Proof Closure: The Terminal Meta-Condition for an Evidence-Bound Subject
description: A bilingual QIK-VRT working paper defining proof closure as the terminal meta-condition for one exactly bound subject: all required proofs valid, provenance bound, verifiers checked, fresh independent readback accepted, boundaries explicit, no open obligations, subject unchanged, and no predecessor-evidence transfer. The bundle explicitly distinguishes closure from universal truth and from the halting problem.
notes: Repository contains executable Python tests and a Lean model. IETF material is an individual Internet-Draft candidate; no IETF endorsement or consensus is claimed.
